svg.title: Изометрическое удержание гантели на бицепс — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. ONE FIGURE only, centered, single full-body three-quarter pose of a standing single-arm isometric dumbbell curl hold. One dumbbell in the right hand at waist height, right upper arm vertical by ribs, elbow bent 90 degrees, forearm clearly horizontal and palm faces up supporting the handle. Left arm relaxed and empty. Upright neutral torso, stable feet; no bench. No second pose, no arrows. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
